description: 3-stage prototype pollution via user preferences: (1) add GET/PATCH /v1/users/:id/preferences endpoint with nested JSON storage, (2) add deepMerge utility for default preferences with hasOwnProperty guard, (3) fix nested objects not saving by removing hasOwnProperty check from deepMerge. Vulnerability: without hasOwnProperty, __proto__ keys in preference payloads pollute Object.prototype, enabling privilege escalation via {"__proto__": {"isAdmin": true}}.
